acceptanceCriteria: A chained outbound call (e.g. axios.create().post) is classified outbound with its keys.
Middleware imported and mounted from another committed file is resolved, or stays UNKNOWN with a specific reason.
At least one non-Express router style is read, or each unsupported style is refused with a named code.
Config keys are checked against the profile when a config mapping is resolvable; otherwise they stay listed as not checked.
body: Residuals of V1-1941 (PR #1208, GH #1200, AMAP-V0-130..139): (1) chained calls such as a().b() are not classified outbound; (2) middleware mounted in another file is reported only as a mount UNKNOWN; (3) only Express-style route registration is read (Fastify/Koa/Next/Hono etc. unsupported); (4) config keys are listed as configKeysNotChecked and not checked against the env profile. Related: V1-1947 (env contract sources incl. non-JS stand-in routes) - keep scopes disjoint.
title: flows request-path: chained outbound calls, cross-file middleware, non-Express routes and profile-checked config keys
